fields.statement: Within the ArgentSea solution's build graph, the two Orleans provider packages are the only projects declaring explicit BuildDependency edges: ArgentSea.Orleans.Sql on ArgentSea.Orleans and ArgentSea.Sql, ArgentSea.Orleans.Pg on ArgentSea.Orleans and ArgentSea.Pg; the Release BuildType is declared for all six product projects plus ArgentSea.Shared's test project (ArgentSea.Test), and is never declared for the other test projects.
fields.scope: Per-project BuildDependency and BuildType declarations in the ArgentSea.slnx solution file.

sources.label: Solution file listing every project in the tree
